text:
morgan: Heads up — multiple GPU pods in us-west-2 (ml-prod) are CrashLoopBackOff after last night's GitOps deploy. Logs show env var missing: GPU_LICENSE_KEY.
ops-bot: ALERT: secret 'gpu-runner-creds' not found in namespace ml-prod-usw2 (detected by secret-monitor).
jia: I merged a small Helm values change last night to enable the new metrics sidecar, but that shouldn't touch secrets. cc @morgan
sam: I saw errors from sealed-secrets controller around 02:10 UTC: `Error decrypting secret: invalid key` — might be a KMS/issuer mismatch. quick command I ran: `kubectl -n kube-system logs sealed-secrets-controller-7f6d8`
devsecops-bot: Policy scan: repo infra/helm/ml-values.yaml contained base64 secret in plaintext on branch feature/metrics-sidecar. Flagged for remediation.
alex: We're in a mixed state: the CI recently started injecting runtime secrets via argocd-vault-plugin (AVP) in eu-central only, while us-west still expects sealed-secrets/SOPS artifacts. The deploy pipeline didn't flip the Argo config for us-west, so K8s has no secret and pods crash.
morgan: oh nice catch. so two parallel secret flows — SOPS sealed secrets (encrypted in Git) vs AVP runtime injection. We need a short rollback to sealed-secrets for us-west and a plan to standardize. :exclamation:
jia: Agree. Plan suggestion: 1) recreate sealed secret for gpu-runner-creds (sops encrypted) and apply to ml-prod-usw2, 2) sync Argo for namespace, 3) monitor. Canary one deployment first.
sam: Steps I can run now (dry run):
```
# re-encrypt values
sops -e infra/helm/gpu/values-ml-prod-usw2.yaml > sealed-values.yaml
kubectl apply -f sealed-secret-gpu-runner.yaml
argocd app sync ml-prod-usw2 --resource namespace/ml-prod
kubectl -n ml-prod-usw2 rollout status deploy/gpu-runner -w
```
I'll not apply without ack.
alex: Also noticed terraform drift: `terraform plan` shows `module.gpu_pool.count` drift from 10 -> 8 (someone manually scaled nodes). That could have reduced capacity and triggered fallback behavior in the autoscaler. Command: `terraform plan -var-file=prod.tfvars` — please lock state before making changes.
morgan: Good call. We should avoid manual kubectl scale on infra resources. Add a pre-merge CI check to run `terraform plan -detailed-exitcode` and fail if drift detected.
devsecops-bot: Proposal: add a pipeline stage `secrets:validate` that runs both SOPS decryption and AVP config linting. Example GH Action step: `- name: validate secrets; run: ./ci/validate-secrets.sh` (script checks sops decrypt and presence of AVP mapping in argocd config)
jia: For immediate mitigation I approve Sam's canary. After recovery we need a migration plan: either fully switch to AVP (argocd-vault-plugin) across regions OR convert AVP mappings into sealed-secrets objects (using sealed-secrets controller + SOPS KMS). We must pick one and document.
sam: I'll create a sealed secret using the SOPS KMS key we use in us-west. Patch below (template):
```
apiVersion: bitnami.com/v1alpha1
kind: SealedSecret
metadata:
  name: gpu-runner-creds
  namespace: ml-prod-usw2
spec:
  encryptedData:
    GPU_LICENSE_KEY: <sops-encrypted-block>
```
Then `kubectl apply -f` and Argo will reconcile.
alex: Ops caveat: if we reintroduce sealed-secrets, ensure controller has correct KMS access: aws kms:Decrypt to the arn used by sops. Also check sealed-secrets operator version compatibility (we saw `invalid key` errors).
morgan: Ops action items: @sam apply sealedsecret as canary, @alex verify KMS permissions + sealed-secrets version, @jia coordinate PR to CI adding secrets validation and terraform-plan check, @devsecops-bot add a runbook entry. Timeline: aim to have canary fixed in 30m, full roll in 3 hours if green.
ops-bot: NOTE: fallback autoscaling policy triggered -> moved some pods to eu-central-1 (latency increased ~120ms). Cost impact: cross-region traffic + GPU spot differences — finance flagged as potential surge.
devsecops-bot: Added runbook stub: `/runbooks/secrets-migration.md` (needs fill) and created issue INFRA-342 to standardize secret distribution.
morgan: Thanks everyone. Sam — ping when canary applied and paste `kubectl get pods -n ml-prod-usw2` output. We'll follow up with a decision doc (AVP vs SOPS sealed-secrets) tomorrow. :handshake:
